# Lesson 13, Part 1.12: regenerate the Go code from .proto (README section 6; slides 15-16), 2026-10-27.
# Working directory: libratrack-grpc-demo/. Plugins pinned by the Makefile; protoc 36.2 from Homebrew (docs/environment.txt).
# The regenerated files are compared with the committed ones, built and tested, then the diff is reverted
# (the committed code stays as shipped by the course).

$ make tools
go install google.golang.org/protobuf/cmd/protoc-gen-go@v1.34.2
go install google.golang.org/grpc/cmd/protoc-gen-go-grpc@v1.5.1
go install github.com/grpc-ecosystem/grpc-gateway/v2/protoc-gen-grpc-gateway@v2.20.0
(exit 0)

$ make proto
protoc -I proto -I third_party \
	  --go_out=. --go_opt=module=libratrack \
	  --go-grpc_out=. --go-grpc_opt=module=libratrack \
	  --grpc-gateway_out=. --grpc-gateway_opt=module=libratrack \
	  proto/inventory.proto
(exit 0)

$ git status --short gen/
 M gen/inventory/inventory.pb.go
 M gen/inventory/inventory_grpc.pb.go
(exit 0)

$ git diff --stat gen/
 libratrack-grpc-demo/gen/inventory/inventory.pb.go      | 2 +-
 libratrack-grpc-demo/gen/inventory/inventory_grpc.pb.go | 2 +-
 2 files changed, 2 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)
(exit 0)

$ git diff gen/ | grep "^[-+]" | grep -v "^[-+][-+]" | sort | uniq -c
   1 +// 	protoc        v7.36.2
   1 +// - protoc             v7.36.2
   1 -// 	protoc        v3.21.12
   1 -// - protoc             v3.21.12
(exit 0)

$ go build ./... && go test ./internal/server -count=1
ok  	libratrack/internal/server	0.265s
(exit 0)

$ git checkout -- gen/
(exit 0)

$ git status --short gen/
(exit 0)
